column3: Scenario
column4: What the tester should say
column5: Expected Response

column3: Caller cannot hear: one slower repeat, then a polite close
column4: [Outbound] "हैलो? आवाज़ नहीं आ रही।" then "हैलो… कुछ सुनाई नहीं दे रहा।"
column5: The bot repeats the check once, slower: "हैलो? क्या अब मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?"; after the second failure it closes: "लगता है लाइन ठीक नहीं है, मैं बाद में कॉल करती हूँ। Goodbye". Pass criteria: exactly one repeat; the introduction, recording notice and college are never spoken; the console shows no get_profile or any other tool call; the call ends after Goodbye.

column3: Audio check, then the campus introduction with a real college name
column4: [Outbound — start from the voice platform console with college_name = "Ghaziabad Institute of Technology", a test contact_name and a recommendations list] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ जी, वहीं पढ़ता हूँ और काम ढूंढ रहा हूँ।"
column5: Turn 1 is only the audio check "हैलो, मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?" and then silence. After the reply comes ONE introduction turn: "नमस्ते। मैं माया, [college] की ओर से बात कर रही हूँ। हम आपके रोज़गार से जुड़ी कुछ जॉब्स की जानकारी देने के लिए कॉल कर रही हूँ। यह बातचीत रिकॉर्ड की जा सकती है। क्या आप [college] की स्टूडेंट हैं और अभी काम ढूंढ रहे हैं?" with the college spoken in Hindi script (e.g. "गाज़ियाबाद इंस्टिट्यूट ऑफ़ टेक्नोलॉजी"). Pass criteria: turn 1 has no greeting, college, purpose or recording notice; the introduction names the college that was passed (never another college, never सरकार / शहर प्रशासन / ज़िला प्रशासन); the recording notice comes before the question and the turn ends on that one question; Maya speaks of herself in the feminine ("कर रही हूँ"); the voice platform console shows NO tool call during the introduction turn — get_profile fires only after the tester answers it; the caller's name is not spoken before get_profile has returned; the introduction is never repeated later in the call.

column3: Inbound welcome, silent lookup, then the account-and-terms question
column4: [Inbound — dial +91 120 441 3383 from a number never registered on Blue Dots] "मुझे डेटा एंट्री का काम चाहिए।" then "हाँ, ठीक है।"
column5: The bot opens with "नमस्ते। माया की रोज़गार सेवा में आपका स्वागत है। यह बातचीत रिकॉर्ड की जा सकती है। बताइए, आप किस तरह का काम ढूंढ रहे हैं?" and waits. After the reply it looks the number up silently, then asks the terms question as its own turn ("अगर हम आगे बढ़ें, तो ब्लू डॉट्स पर … क्या मैं आपकी तरफ़ से शर्तें स्वीकार कर लूँ?"); on yes, "ठीक है, धन्यवाद।" and it continues with the data-entry request. Pass criteria: no audio check and no "मैं कॉल कर रही हूँ" (the caller rang in); no college named (none is configured) and no government framing; console: get_profile is the first tool, fires exactly once, with the caller's own number (12 digits starting 91, no '+'); no job talk before the terms question is settled; record_consent is not called for a brand-new number; no lookup narration ("आपकी जानकारी देख रही हूँ") and the welcome is never repeated.

column3: College name missing, empty, or arriving as the raw ${college_name} token
column4: [Outbound — start with college_name left out entirely; repeat with college_name = ""] "हाँ, आ रही है।"
column5: The bot uses the no-college opener: "नमस्ते। मैं माया बोल रही हूँ। हम आपके रोज़गार से जुड़ी कुछ जॉब्स की जानकारी देने के लिए कॉल कर रही हूँ। यह बातचीत रिकॉर्ड की जा सकती है। क्या आप अभी काम ढूंढ रहे हैं?" (the short form "मैं माया, रोज़गार से जुड़ी जानकारी के लिए कॉल कर रही हूँ।" is also acceptable). Pass criteria: no institution is named at all — in particular never "एलआर कॉलेज" (the prompt's own example college); the caller never hears "college name", "कॉलेज नेम", "डॉलर", brackets or "आपके कॉलेज की ओर से"; the "…की स्टूडेंट हैं" clause is dropped. Regression: an earlier test call said "मैं माया, [college] की ओर से" aloud.

column3: English-initial college name is spoken once, in Hindi script, and never dropped
column4: [Outbound — run twice: (1) college_name = "VMLG College" with contact_memory = "Not Available"; (2) college_name = "VTU"] "हाँ, आ रही है।"
column5: The opener names the college: "नमस्ते। मैं माया, वीएमएलजी कॉलेज की ओर से बात कर रही हूँ। …" (second run: "वीटीयू"). Pass criteria: the college is said in Hindi script as one compact word each time it appears — never in English letters and never twice in a row like "वीटीयू (VTU)"; the "Not Available" memory does NOT switch the bot to the no-college opener; never names a different college such as "एलआर कॉलेज". Regressions 2026-09-08 (opened with no college / said "VMLG College" in English) and 2026-09-09 (abbreviation read twice). The no-college opener firing despite a real name is a known open issue — record the call if it happens.

column3: New number: silent profile lookup, then the account-and-terms question as its own turn
column4: [Outbound — a number never registered on Blue Dots] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, काम ढूंढ रहा हूँ।" then "हाँ, कर लीजिए।"
column5: After the tester answers the introduction, the bot looks the number up silently (at most a neutral "एक मिनट" is heard) and then asks, on its own turn: "अगर हम आगे बढ़ें, तो ब्लू डॉट्स पर आपके नाम और फ़ोन नंबर से एक अकाउंट बनेगा। … क्या मैं आपकी तरफ़ से शर्तें स्वीकार कर लूँ?" On yes it says a short "ठीक है, धन्यवाद।" and moves on to work questions. Pass criteria: get_profile is called exactly once (console) and never again later in the call; record_consent is NOT called (there is no profile yet); the question carries all five parts — account made from name and phone number, the three purposes, one year, managed by EkStep Foundation, full terms on the Blue Dots app — and is not glued onto the introduction turn; never says "प्रोफाइल", "आपकी जानकारी देख रही हूँ", "आपकी जानकारी मिल गई" or "आपका अकाउंट बन गया है"; no job talk before this question is settled; the introduction is not repeated after the lookup (regression 2026-09-03).

column3: Unclear answer gets one shorter re-ask; a no ends the call with nothing written
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered on Blue Dots] at the terms question: "मतलब? ये क्या है?" then "नहीं, मुझे कोई अकाउंट नहीं बनवाना।"
column5: After the unclear reply, ONE shorter re-ask: "बस इतना बता दीजिए — क्या मैं आपकी तरफ़ से शर्तें स्वीकार कर लूँ?". After the no: "कोई बात नहीं। अगर आप बाद में मन बदलें, तो कभी भी वापस कॉल कर सकती हैं। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद। Goodbye". Pass criteria: no third ask and no persuasion; no jobs presented after the decline; the console shows no record_consent, create_profile or apply_job; the call ends on Goodbye. (The prompt contradicts itself on whether the MPL offer should come before this Goodbye — record what happens, do not fail on it; see findings.)

column3: Returning caller with a complete profile is greeted by name and applies directly
column4: [Outbound — a test number that already has a complete live profile (e.g. the number used in the new-caller apply case); pick a job not applied to before] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ जी।" then "हाँ, वही काम देख रहा हूँ।" … "हाँ, अप्लाई कर दीजिए।" then "हाँ, जा सकता हूँ।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) Right after the lookup, ONE turn: "[पहला नाम] जी, आप अभी [role] का काम कर रहे हैं — क्या आप अभी भी [role] की जॉब देख रहे हैं?" and then silence. Then location, jobs, details, the sharing question naming the company and role, the interview question once, and the result. Pass criteria: name and role come from the saved profile (never from memory); no "आपकी जानकारी मिल गई"; no terms question (already accepted) and no save-details question; the role-check turn has no area question and no job list; age and gender are NOT asked; the console shows NO create_profile and NO record_consent — only apply_job, on the existing live profile; the sharing question is still asked before apply_job (returning callers are not exempt).

column3: An earlier call is mentioned only when memory really has one
column4: [Outbound — a number with a live profile. Call A: no earlier Maya calls on this number (e.g. a profile made through another bot or the app), contact_memory = "Not Available". Call B: the same number after Call A (or pass a contact_memory that holds a previous-call summary)] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ जी।"
column5: Call A: name + role check only — "[पहला नाम] जी, आप अभी [role] का काम कर रहे हैं — क्या आप अभी भी [role] की जॉब देख रहे हैं?". Call B: the same turn may add ONE short clause, "पिछली बार हमारी बात [what the memory records] के बारे में हुई थी", naming only what actually happened. Pass criteria: Call A never says "पिछली बार" or claims an earlier conversation (a false claim to a first-time caller); neither call invents a role, company or outcome, says "कुछ दिन पहले" without a date, or says "मेमोरी" / "रिकॉर्ड"; the turn still ends on the single role question.

column3: Saved role is a placeholder ("Any") or a degree
column4: [Either direction — a number whose saved role is "Any" or a degree such as "B.Tech" (ask the Prompt Tuner team to set one up)] "हाँ जी।" then "कुछ भी चल जाएगा।"
column5: The bot skips the role check and gives the overview instead: first name (if usable) + the real kinds of work in its list + "आप किस तरह का काम देख रहे हैं — या कोई भी चलेगा?". Pass criteria: never says "आप Any का काम…", "बी.टेक का काम कर रहे हैं" or any placeholder or degree as a job; the kinds named are only roles in the job list (outbound: not the prompt's sample "डेटा एंट्री और ऑफिस के काम, कस्टमर सपोर्ट, और टेलीकॉलिंग" unless those are in the recommendations; inbound: only the four list roles); no itemised jobs in that turn.

column3: Caller now wants a different kind of work
column4: [Either direction — a returning number with a live profile and a saved role] at the role check: "नहीं, अब मुझे प्रोडक्शन का काम चाहिए।"
column5: (changes the saved role on a real profile — use a test number) The bot acknowledges in the caller's words — "ठीक है, प्रोडक्शन की जॉब्स देखती हूँ।" — saves the new role silently and carries on. Pass criteria: no permission question ("क्या मैं बदल दूँ?") in any wording; the console shows one update_profile on the existing profile with role = the new role in English letters, and no create_profile; no claim that such jobs exist before they are actually listed; if none exist it says so plainly.

column3: Experienced new caller: experience gathered one step at a time
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered; after the terms question] "हाँ, पहले काम किया है।" then "कॉल सेंटर में, कस्टमर सर्विस।" then "नोएडा की एक कंपनी में।" then "दो साल।"
column5: The bot asks "क्या आपको पहले से किसी काम का experience है?" and then the follow-ups one at a time (what work, where, how many years) — never all at once — and then moves on to jobs. Pass criteria: one question per turn; experience is not asked again at the apply step; call output experience_captured = Yes; if the tester goes on to apply (creates a real application — use a test number), create_profile carries workExperience = "Worked before". A returning caller whose profile already has role and experience must NOT get these questions.

column3: Undecided caller hears only real kinds of work, then three real jobs
column4: [Inbound — new number, continue after the terms question] "पता नहीं, कुछ भी चल जाएगा।" then "कोई भी चलेगा।" then "कहीं भी चलेगा।"
column5: The bot gives a short overview naming only work that exists in its job list (HR admin executive, production worker, computer operator or data entry, tailoring trainer) and asks what they want; then the area question as its own turn; then up to three of those jobs with "पहला / दूसरा / तीसरा". Pass criteria: the overview never mentions कस्टमर सपोर्ट, कॉल सेंटर, ईवी चार्जिंग, एसी टेक्नीशियन, इलेक्ट्रीशियन, बेंगलुरु or रिमोट (none of these exist — see findings); no company, salary or job count in the overview; every job listed is one of the four in the inbound list (HR Admin Executive – Saarthi Staffing Solutions; Production Worker – Lava International; Computer Operator / Data Entry – NIIT; Vocational Trainer – Tailoring – Udyogini) with its own place and salary.

column3: A location already on hand is confirmed, never asked from scratch
column4: [Outbound — location = "Sarjapur, 110045" (repeat with "Ghaziabad"). Inbound — a returning number whose saved profile has a location] "हाँ।"
column5: The bot confirms instead of asking openly: "आप [जगह] के आसपास ही देखें?" and on "हाँ" goes straight to the jobs. Pass criteria: only the town or area is spoken ("सरजापुर", "गाज़ियाबाद") — never the PIN 110045 in any form (digits, Hindi digits or spelled out) and never a full postal address; the open question ("किस इलाके में देखें…" / "किस इलाके के पास काम करना चाहेंगे…") is NOT asked when a location is on hand; a missing location (raw token) is never read aloud. Regression 2026-09-01 / 2026-09-04 (location asked from scratch despite the input).

column3: Only jobs from the recommendations list, role-matched, not padded to three
column4: [Outbound — recommendations = 3 to 6 real jobs of different roles, exactly one of them a data-entry job; location = "Ghaziabad"; answer any other question briefly] "डेटा एंट्री का काम चाहिए।" then "हाँ, गाज़ियाबाद ठीक है।"
column5: The bot confirms the location it already has ("आप गाज़ियाबाद के आसपास ही देखें?") and then presents ONLY the data-entry job, in the one-job format: "आपके लिए यह जॉब है — [role], [company], [location], सैलरी [salary]. इसके बारे में और बात करें?" — e.g. for the live Computer Operator / Data Entry job at NIIT: "कंप्यूटर ऑपरेटर या डेटा एंट्री, एनआईआईटी लिमिटेड, …, सैलरी बारह हज़ार से सोलह हज़ार". Pass criteria: every role, company, place and salary spoken matches an entry you sent; no unrelated job is added to make up three; no job count is spoken; salary in Hindi words, no digits; names in Hindi script; "/" spoken as "या"; job ids never spoken; the console shows no get_jobs call.

column2: Step 2 — Match and present available jobs
column3: Data-entry request is matched to the one real data-entry job
column4: [Inbound — continue after the terms question] "नहीं, पहले कभी काम नहीं किया।" then "कहीं भी चलेगा।" then "इसके बारे में और बताइए।"
column5: The bot presents only the list's data-entry job in the one-job format, e.g. "आपके लिए यह जॉब है — कंप्यूटर ऑपरेटर या डेटा एंट्री, एनआईआईटी लिमिटेड, राज नगर डिस्ट्रिक्ट सेंटर, सैलरी बारह हज़ार से सोलह हज़ार. इसके बारे में और बात करें?"; the details add "दस पोज़िशन हैं" and "क्वालिफिकेशन: बारहवीं पास". Pass criteria: no other job is offered as a data-entry match — never "डेटा एंट्री ऑपरेटर, काशी इंफोटेक, बेंगलुरु" (not in the list); "/" spoken as "या", never "स्लैश"; salary and vacancy in words, not digits; no HR number and no benefits mentioned (this job has neither); never says "इन्वेंटरी" or "लिस्ट".

column3: Long list and repeated requests for more jobs
column4: [Outbound — recommendations = 15 to 28 real jobs] "कोई भी चलेगा।" then "और कौन सी जॉब्स हैं?" then "जो भी हैं सब बताइए।" then "और?" (ask for more 3–4 times)
column5: First batch "पहला… दूसरा… तीसरा…"; each request for more gets either the next batch with continuing numbers ("चौथा…") or "किस तरह का काम देख रहे हैं? मैं उसी हिसाब से बताती हूँ।" followed by matching jobs. Pass criteria: numbering never restarts at पहला; no job (same role + company + place) is named twice; never says how many jobs there are ("बीस जॉब्स", "तीन में से"); never says the list is finished or there are no more jobs while unnamed jobs remain; no MPL or service-provider offer while jobs remain unheard. Note: entries with the same role and company at different places are different jobs and may each be named (see findings). Regression 2026-09-03.

column3: Masked location in the job data
column4: [Outbound — recommendations whose location fields are masked, e.g. "V***", "S***"] "कोई भी चलेगा।" then "पहले वाली के बारे में बताइए।"
column5: The bot presents each job with the fields it has and simply leaves the place out — "पहला: [role], [company], सैलरी …". Pass criteria: never reads the mask ("वी स्टार स्टार", "V***"); never invents a city, company, role or salary that is not in the data you sent; the details turn also leaves the place out; if the tester applies, apply_job carries the id of the job picked, not another one. Regression: a live call once read out three invented jobs when the places were masked.

column3: Caller wants a city where there are no jobs
column4: [Outbound — location = "Ghaziabad", all recommendations in Ghaziabad] "मुझे सिर्फ़ बेंगलुरु में काम चाहिए।" then "अच्छा, गाज़ियाबाद वाले बताइए।"
column5: The bot does not claim Bengaluru jobs; it says what it has and where (Ghaziabad) and lets the caller decide, then presents those jobs. Pass criteria: never says "अभी आपके लिए मुझे जॉब्स नहीं मिल रहीं — एक बार फिर से देखकर मैं आपको वापस कॉल करती हूँ।" (that line is only for an empty list); never "बेंगलुरु में जॉब्स हैं"; every job named carries its real place from the data. Regression: a 2026-09-07 test call used the empty-list line while a job was available.

column3: Salary and vacancy spoken as words, not digits
column4: [Either direction] "कोई भी चलेगा।" then "दूसरे वाले के बारे में बताइए।"
column5: Salaries and openings are spoken the way a person says them — e.g. "सैलरी चौदह हज़ार से बीस हज़ार", "तीन पोज़िशन हैं", "पैंतीस पोज़िशन हैं". Pass criteria: no digits in any bot line ("14000", "12,000") and no Hindi numerals ("१२,०००", "२ पोज़िशन"); the spoken amount equals the data (a 30000 salary is never "बारह हज़ार"); no "₹" symbol read out. Regression 2026-09-09 (digits in salary lines on both Maya bots).

column3: Caller asks for a role the list does not have
column4: [Outbound — recommendations = 2 real jobs outside sales / marketing / customer-facing work (e.g. a production job and a data-entry job)] "मुझे मार्केटिंग का काम चाहिए।" then "अच्छा, बताइए।" then "नहीं, इनमें से कोई नहीं चाहिए।"
column5: The bot does not promise marketing jobs. It says the role is not available and names the real kinds: "मार्केटिंग की जॉब अभी नहीं है — लेकिन [kind], [kind] जैसी जॉब्स हैं। इनमें से कुछ देखना चाहेंगे?" — and stops on that question. After both jobs are heard and declined: "मैंने जो जॉब्स बताईं — [role], [role] — फिलहाल हमारे पास वही हैं। नई जॉब्स आते ही हम आपको बता देंगे।". Pass criteria: never "आपके लिए गाज़ियाबाद में मार्केटिंग से जुड़ी कुछ जॉब्स हैं" or any other claim that marketing jobs exist; never the retired line "अभी आपके लिए कोई relevant जॉब नहीं दिख रही"; nothing (MPL, goodbye) is added to the "…देखना चाहेंगे?" turn — the MPL offer comes later in its own turn; "[role]" / "[kind]" are never spoken as words.

column3: Empty recommendations list
column4: [Outbound — recommendations = [] (empty)] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, काम ढूंढ रहा हूँ।" then "नहीं, धन्यवाद।" (to each offer)
column5: The bot says exactly "अभी आपके लिए मुझे जॉब्स नहीं मिल रहीं — एक बार फिर से देखकर मैं आपको वापस कॉल करती हूँ।", then offers the competition once in its own turn ("इससे पहले कि हम बात खत्म करें — क्या मैं आपको एक फ्री कॉम्पिटिशन, गाज़ियाबाद मार्केटर प्रीमियर लीग, के बारे में बताऊँ?"), makes one service-provider offer, and closes with Goodbye. Pass criteria: no job, company or salary is ever named; the console shows no apply_job and no create_profile; each offer is made once and in its own turn; Goodbye is the last word. (Whether the audio check, introduction and terms question still run here is unclear in the prompt — note it; see findings.)

column3: Requests for work the inbound list does not have (call centre, electrician, AC, Bengaluru)
column4: [Inbound — continue after the terms question] "कॉल सेंटर या कस्टमर सपोर्ट का काम है क्या?" then "अच्छा, इलेक्ट्रीशियन या एसी टेक्नीशियन का?" then "बेंगलुरु में कुछ है?" then "नहीं, ये सब नहीं चाहिए।"
column5: The bot says plainly it has nothing of that kind right now and offers only the kinds it really has (HR admin, production worker, computer operator or data entry, tailoring trainer); if the caller wants none: "अभी आपके लिए इस तरह की कोई relevant जॉब नहीं दिख रही। जैसे ही सही options आएँगे, आप दोबारा बात कर सकते हैं।", then the MPL offer in its own turn. Pass criteria: never presents "कस्टमर सपोर्ट एग्जीक्यूटिव, रामपुर टेक्नोलॉजीज़, रिमोट", "ईवी चार्जिंग टेक्नीशियन, यमुना सोलर एनर्जी", any AC-technician, Bengaluru or remote job, or "काशी इंफोटेक" — none of these exist (see findings); never passes off a real list job as a call-centre or technician job; apply_job never fires on a job outside the four in the inbound prompt; never says "इन्वेंटरी".

column3: Job details, then "no questions" moves on to the apply question
column4: [Either direction] "पहले वाली के बारे में बताइए।" then "नहीं, कुछ नहीं पूछना।" then "अभी नहीं, बाद में।"
column5: One details turn: "[role], [company] में, [location] — सैलरी …, … पोज़िशन हैं। क्वालिफिकेशन: …। इस जॉब के बारे में कुछ पूछना है?" and stop. "नहीं, कुछ नहीं पूछना" means no doubts → the next turn is the apply question with the sharing line. "अभी नहीं, बाद में" is a refusal → no apply. Pass criteria: the details turn has only one question (no "अप्लाई कर दूँ?" in it); no HR number at this stage; benefits get one short clause only if the job data has them (outbound: add a benefits value to check; inbound jobs have none, so none are mentioned); "no questions" never ends the call or switches to another job; after the refusal the console shows no apply_job or create_profile and the bot offers another job or moves to close without pressure.

column3: New caller rushes to apply; missing details are still collected first
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered; agree to the terms; after choosing a job] "बस जल्दी से अप्लाई कर दो।" then answer each question in one word: "नेहा" / "बाईस" / "हाँ" / "गोविंदपुरम" / "नई शुरुआत" / "हाँ, जा सकती हूँ" / "हाँ"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot still asks only the missing details, one per turn — name (inbound; outbound uses contact_name), age ("आपकी उम्र कितनी है — लगभग बताइए?", with "आपने बाईस साल कहा, सही?" for a short answer), area if not yet known, experience ("इस तरह के काम का अनुभव है, या नई शुरुआत?") — then the interview question once, then the save-details question, then applies. Pass criteria: the console create_profile has non-empty name, age, location, workExperience ("Fresher") and role, all in English letters; gender is NOT asked before the apply; nothing create_profile needed is asked after it ran; nothing already given is asked again; a "no" to the interview question would not stop the apply; call output ready_for_interview = Yes.

column2: Part 2 — Permission to save their details
column3: Caller refuses to have details saved: browse-only call, one offer when they ask to apply
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered; agree to the terms] at the save-details question: "नहीं, सेव मत कीजिए।" … later: "इस जॉब में अप्लाई कर दीजिए।" then "नहीं, सेव नहीं करना।"
column5: The bot says "कोई बात नहीं। आज जो जॉब्स हैं, वो मैं आपको बता देती हूँ।" and keeps talking about jobs. When the caller asks to apply, ONE offer: "इस जॉब में अप्लाई करने के लिए आपकी जानकारी सेव करना ज़रूरी है — क्या अब सेव कर लूँ?"; after the second no, "कोई बात नहीं" and the job talk continues. Pass criteria: the call does NOT end at the first no; no warning about losing the apply right after the first no; the save offer is made only once; the console shows no create_profile and no apply_job; no success line. (The prompt's own examples wrongly end the call here — see findings.)

column3: New caller applies end to end (save details, then apply)
column4: [Outbound — a number never registered on Blue Dots; agree to the terms question first; answer the experience follow-ups briefly] "हाँ, एक साल कॉल सेंटर में काम किया है।" … "पहले वाली के बारे में बताइए।" then "नहीं, कुछ नहीं पूछना।" then "हाँ, अप्लाई कर दीजिए।" then "बाईस साल।" then "हाँ, जा सकता हूँ।" then "हाँ, सेव कर लीजिए।" (and "हाँ" if the sharing question is asked again)
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot gives the job details ending on "इस जॉब के बारे में कुछ पूछना है?"; then, in a separate turn, the sharing question for that job: "आपकी personal details [company] के साथ [role] के काम के लिए शेयर होंगी। वे आपसे सीधे संपर्क कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं अप्लाई कर दूँ?"; then only the missing details, one per turn (age: "आपकी उम्र कितनी है — लगभग बताइए?"); the interview question once ("अगर employer आपको shortlist करते हैं, तो क्या आप interview के लिए जा सकते हैं? …"); the save-details question ("आगे बढ़ने के लिए मुझे आपकी कुछ जानकारी सेव करनी होगी — … क्या मैं यह जानकारी सेव कर लूँ?"); at most "ठीक है।"; then "अप्लाई हो गया है। [company] की तरफ़ से shortlist होने पर इसी नंबर पर call या message आता है। Exact timing अलग हो सकती है।" Pass criteria: the console shows create_profile and then, as a separate later step, apply_job (never in the same batch); apply_job uses the item id returned by create_profile and the chosen job's id; the success line comes only after apply_job returned success; gender is NOT asked before the apply; the name comes from contact_name (not asked if it was passed); no "अप्लाई कर देती हूँ" / "आवेदन भेज रही हूँ" before the result; call output applied_to_job = Yes and unbacked_apply_claim = No.

column3: Inbound new caller applies end to end; no HR number exists to share
column4: [Inbound — a number never registered on Blue Dots; agree to the terms question; answer each question in a word] "प्रोडक्शन का काम चाहिए।" … "हाँ, यही।" then "नहीं, कुछ नहीं पूछना।" then "हाँ, कर दीजिए।" then "राहुल" / "चौबीस साल" / "सूरजपुर" / "नहीं, फ्रेशर हूँ" as asked, then "हाँ, जा सकता हूँ।" then "हाँ, सेव कर लीजिए।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot presents the Production Worker job ("प्रोडक्शन वर्कर, लावा इंटरनेशनल लिमिटेड, सूरजपुर इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया, सैलरी दस हज़ार से चौदह हज़ार"), gives details, asks the sharing question naming the company and role, asks only the missing details one per turn (the name IS asked — inbound has no contact name), the interview question once, the save-details question, then applies and says the success line. Pass criteria: the console shows get_profile → create_profile → apply_job, with create and apply in separate steps; apply_job's job is the Production Worker job from the inbound prompt's list; the success line only after an apply_job success; NO HR number is spoken and the line "…हम कंपनी का एच आर नंबर भी आपके साथ शेयर कर देंगे" is never said (no list job has an HR number); call output hr_contact_shared = No, applied_to_job = Yes.

column3: Caller picks straight from the list and says "apply"
column4: [Either direction — right after the job list] "पहले वाली जॉब में अप्लाई कर दीजिए।" then "हाँ।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) Even though the caller asked to apply, the bot first asks the sharing question as the only question in the turn: "आपकी personal details [company] के साथ [role] के काम के लिए शेयर होंगी। वे आपसे सीधे संपर्क कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं अप्लाई कर दूँ?" — with that job's company and role in Hindi script — and applies only after the yes. Pass criteria: the console shows apply_job only after this question was answered; it names the chosen job's company and role (a masked company becomes "इस कंपनी के साथ"); no second apply question in the same turn ("अप्लाई करना है?" + the sharing line). (On the new-caller path a second sharing question just before the apply is acceptable — see findings.)

column3: Second application in the same call
column4: [Either direction — right after a successful apply and the follow-up questions] "हाँ, एक और जॉब देखनी है।" then pick a different job, then "हाँ, इसमें भी अप्लाई कर दीजिए।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot shows remaining jobs (never the one already applied to), asks the sharing question again for the NEW job's company and role, "आपकी personal details [company] के साथ [role] के काम के लिए शेयर होंगी। वे आपसे सीधे संपर्क कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं अप्लाई कर दूँ?", and applies after the yes. Pass criteria: the console shows a second apply_job with the same profile and the new job, and NO second create_profile; age, gender, the interview question and the save-details question are NOT asked again; the MPL offer is not repeated.

column3: Asking to apply again to a job already applied to in this call
column4: [Either direction — right after a successful apply] "उसी जॉब में फिर से अप्लाई कर दीजिए।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot says plainly, without apology: "इस जॉब के लिए आपकी एप्लीकेशन पहले से लगी हुई है — दोबारा अप्लाई करने की ज़रूरत नहीं। क्या मैं आपको दूसरी जॉब्स बताऊँ?". Pass criteria: the console shows no second apply_job for that job after this request (one more is allowed only if the caller insists again, and must still end on this line, never the success line); never "तकनीकी दिक्कत" / "technical issue", never a callback promise. Regression 2026-09-01 / 2026-09-04 (already-applied jobs were reported as a technical issue).

column3: HR number shared after a successful apply, only when the job has one
column4: [Outbound — add an hr_contact (a test number you own) to one real recommendation entry] pick that job and apply: "हाँ, अप्लाई कर दीजिए।" then "नंबर फिर से बताइए।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) Right after "अप्लाई हो गया है…", the bot shares the number once, digit by digit in words: "कंपनी का एच आर नंबर भी बता देती हूँ — …", and repeats it on request. Pass criteria: every digit spoken in order with none dropped (count them — a repeated digit like "नौ, नौ" must appear twice); the number is never spoken before the apply succeeded (not in the list or the details); no promise that HR will call; the line "अगर आप किसी जॉब में अप्लाई करते हैं, तो जहाँ उपलब्ध होगा, हम कंपनी का एच आर नंबर भी आपके साथ शेयर कर देंगे।" is said at most once; a job without an HR number gets none; call output hr_contact_shared = Yes.

column3: After a successful apply: missing details, read-back, MPL offer, service-provider offer, Goodbye
column4: [Either direction — continue right after the success line of an apply; answer one thing per turn] "महिला।" (if asked) then "ग्रेजुएशन।" then "बी.कॉम।" then "नहीं, किसी चीज़ की ज़रूरत नहीं।" then "राज नगर में।" then "हाँ, सब सही है।" then "नहीं, अभी नहीं।" then "नहीं, और जॉब नहीं।" then "नहीं, धन्यवाद।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) Bridge once: "आपकी जानकारी पूरी करने के लिए कुछ छोटी बातें पूछ लूँ।"; then ONE question per turn, only for details not already saved (gender only if missing, qualification + one follow-up, other help needed, area). Then a labelled read-back on its own: "एक बार confirm कर लूँ — आपका नाम …, उम्र …, …, काम …, पढ़ाई …, एरिया … — सब सही?". Next turn, alone: "क्या मैं आपको एक फ्री कॉम्पिटिशन, गाज़ियाबाद मार्केटर प्रीमियर लीग, के बारे में बताऊँ?". After the reply: "अच्छा — कोई और जॉब देखनी है?", then ONE service-provider offer ("जॉब मिलने के चांस और बढ़ाने के लिए हमारे पास कुछ सर्विस प्रोवाइडर हैं जो आपकी मदद कर सकते हैं। क्या आप इंटरेस्टेड हैं?"), then the closing line (outbound "…ज़रूरत होने पर हमारी टीम आपसे फिर बात करेगी। Goodbye", inbound "…जब भी फिर से देखना हो, बात कीजिए। Goodbye"). Pass criteria: the console shows one update_profile per answered topic, carrying only the new fields, with no error result; "नोट कर लिया" is said at most once per update; the read-back gives age in words and gender in Hindi ("महिला" / "पुरुष", never "Female" / "female"), never reads the phone number, and nothing else is in that turn; the MPL question is its own turn with no Goodbye in it and is never repeated; the service-provider offer comes once and names no partner (no TRRAIN); "Goodbye" is the last word; call output mpl_presented = Yes, service_provider_pitched = Yes.

column3: Apply fails: one neutral failure line, then only the offer of another job
column4: [Outbound — one recommendation carries a made-up but well-formed job id] pick that job and agree to apply, then "दोबारा उसी में कोशिश कीजिए।" then "नहीं, दूसरी नहीं चाहिए।" then "नहीं।"
column5: (apply attempt on a fake job id — no real application is created; use a test number) The bot starts directly with "इस जॉब के लिए आपकी दिलचस्पी हमने नोट कर ली है — इसकी अपडेट हमारी टीम आपको इसी नंबर पर देगी। क्या मैं आपको दूसरी जॉब्स बताऊँ?" and stops. Asked to retry, it does not retry that job. Before ending it offers the competition in its own turn ("इससे पहले कि हम बात खत्म करें — …"), then the service-provider offer, then Goodbye. Pass criteria: the console shows exactly one apply_job for that job id; the failure turn holds nothing else (no MPL, no service-provider offer, no goodbye, no repeated "अप्लाई कर देती हूँ"); never "technical issue" / "तकनीकी दिक्कत", never blames the caller's phone, never "आप बाद में call कीजिए"; "अप्लाई हो गया है" is never said anywhere in the call; call output unbacked_apply_claim = No and jobs_failed_to_apply lists the job. (If the MPL offer is skipped after the failure, log it — the prompt is contradictory here; see findings.)

column3: Caller asks about the competition and registers
column4: [Either direction — reach the MPL offer by any path] "हाँ, बताइए।" then "इसमें करना क्या होता है?" then "कोई फीस है?" then "ठीक है, रजिस्टर कर दीजिए।"
column5: (registers the number for a real MPL follow-up call — use a test number) The bot explains only what is asked, one point at a time (a free competition; a 10–15 minute phone call with simple conversation-style questions; a free verified certificate), confirms there is no fee, and on yes says "बढ़िया! आपको अगले अड़तालीस घंटों में, शाम छह से आठ बजे के बीच एक कॉल आएगा — वही असल competition है। …"; before ending, one reminder: "याद रखिएगा — MPL की कॉल अगले अड़तालीस घंटों में, शाम छह से आठ बजे के बीच आएगी। ज़रूर उठाइएगा।". Pass criteria: no fee, no job or salary guarantee, no scoring-criteria names; times in words (no "6-8 PM"); after registering it returns to "अच्छा — कोई और जॉब देखनी है?"; MPL is not raised again; call output mpl_registration = Yes, mpl_presented = Yes.

column3: MPL already offered on an earlier call is not offered again
column4: [Either direction — call again from / re-trigger the same test number after a call in which the MPL offer was made; outbound console runs that pass contact_memory should include "mpl_presented: Yes"] go to the end of the call: "नहीं, और कुछ नहीं।"
column5: The bot skips the competition and uses only the plain job question ("अच्छा — कोई और जॉब देखनी है?" / "क्या कोई और जॉब देखें?"). Pass criteria: "मार्केटर प्रीमियर लीग" / "कॉम्पिटिशन" is never spoken on this call; the last word of the call is Goodbye; call output mpl_presented = No.

column3: One service-provider offer at the end, right wording, one-sentence explanation
column4: [Either direction — hear the jobs but stay undecided; decline MPL] "सोचता हूँ, अभी पक्का नहीं है।" … at the service-provider offer: "ये क्या सर्विस है?" then "हाँ, भेज दीजिए।" then "नहीं, बस।"
column5: After the job talk is over, ONE offer — an undecided caller gets: "मैं समझती हूँ, डिसाइड करना मुश्किल हो सकता है। मेरा सुझाव है कि हम आपको एक सर्विस प्रोवाइडर से जोड़ दें, जो आपके करियर के फैसले में मदद कर सके। क्या मैं आगे भेज दूँ?". The question gets one short answer ("यह एक फ्री सर्विस है — … इसके लिए कोई पैसा नहीं लगता।"). On yes: "बहुत बढ़िया, हमारी टीम आपसे एक-दो दिन में संपर्क करेगी। इसके बारे में कुछ पूछना है?" and it waits. Pass criteria: offered once, never while unheard jobs remain, never in the same turn as another question; no partner or organisation name (TRRAIN or other) is spoken; no Goodbye in the "बहुत बढ़िया" turn; call output service_provider_pitched = Yes, service_provider_interest = Yes. (A caller who applied, or declined for a clear reason such as salary or distance, should hear "जॉब मिलने के चांस और बढ़ाने के लिए…" instead.)

column3: Caller is not looking for a job
column4: [Either direction] at the first work question: "नहीं, मुझे अभी जॉब नहीं चाहिए।" then "नहीं।"
column5: The bot does not push jobs: "कोई बात नहीं। जब भी ज़रूरत हो, हम मदद के लिए यहाँ हैं।", then, in its own turn, "इससे पहले कि हम बात खत्म करें — क्या मैं आपको एक फ्री कॉम्पिटिशन, गाज़ियाबाद मार्केटर प्रीमियर लीग, के बारे में बताऊँ?", waits, then closes with Goodbye. Pass criteria: no job list, no "क्यों?", no re-pitch; the console shows no create_profile or apply_job; the MPL question and Goodbye are in different turns; call output not_interested_in_jobs = Yes. A hesitant "पता नहीं" must NOT trigger this path. (Whether a service-provider offer is also owed here is contradictory in the prompt — do not fail either way; see findings.)

column3: Do-not-call request
column4: [Either direction — at any point] "मुझे दोबारा call मत करना।"
column5: The bot complies at once — outbound: "बिल्कुल। अब हमारी तरफ़ से call नहीं आएगा। कभी ज़रूरत हो, आप खुद संपर्क कर सकते हैं।"; inbound: "बिल्कुल। हम आपको call नहीं करेंगे। जब भी ज़रूरत हो, आप खुद इस नंबर पर बात कर सकते हैं।" — and ends with Goodbye. Pass criteria: no persuasion and no "क्यों"; no MPL offer, no service-provider offer and no jobs after the request; the console shows no create_profile or apply_job after it.

column3: No internal data spoken: ids, payloads, stage directions, phone number, system words
column4: [Either direction — any call that reaches the apply] "मेरी कौन सी डिटेल्स सेव की हैं? सब बताइए।" then "मेरा प्रोफाइल आईडी क्या है?"
column5: The bot answers in plain words only (name, work, area) and never reads stored data or ids. Pass criteria: no bot line contains "{", quoted field names, an item / profile / job / user id, a tool name (get_profile, apply_job…), "INTERNAL", a bracketed stage direction or the caller's phone number; never says "प्रोफाइल", "इन्वेंटरी", "डेटाबेस", "सिस्टम" or "Not Available"; no line claims something was saved or applied unless the matching tool actually ran (console). Regression 2026-09-09 (a stage direction carrying an id and a phone number was read aloud).

column3: Government question and an off-topic request
column4: [Either direction] "आप सरकार की तरफ़ से बोल रही हैं?" … later: "मुझे लोन भी चाहिए, वो दिला देंगी?"
column5: Government: the bot keeps its real identity — the college's campus initiative (outbound: "माया, [college] की ओर से") or "माया की रोज़गार सेवा" (inbound) — with no government link. Loan: a short honest answer with no promise, then back to the job conversation. Pass criteria: never says it is from सरकार, शहर प्रशासन or ज़िला प्रशासन; never promises a loan, money or any help outside jobs; no invented scheme or fact; the call continues from the step it was on.

column3: Job count, guarantee and pressure
column4: [Either direction] "कुल कितनी जॉब्स हैं आपके पास?" … "पक्का नौकरी मिल जाएगी ना?" … "मुझे सोचने का थोड़ा टाइम चाहिए।"
column5: Count: no number — the bot offers to tell jobs by the kind of work wanted. Guarantee: an honest answer with no promise of selection. Time to think: accepted without pressure. Pass criteria: never states a job total ("बीस जॉब्स", "तीस से ज़्यादा"); never says "पक्का मिलेगा", "गारंटीड जॉब", "सौ प्रतिशत", "डोंट वरी", "सब ठीक हो जाएगा", "अभी decide कीजिए" or "यह मौका चला जाएगा"; no apply happens without a clear yes.

column3: "Are you a real person?" and a question the job data cannot answer
column4: [Either direction] "क्या आप असली इंसान हैं?" … during the job details: "इसकी शिफ्ट टाइमिंग क्या है?" then "टाइमिंग तो बताइए ना।"
column5: AI question: "जी, मैं एक AI असिस्टेंट हूँ — आपकी मदद के लिए।" and back to the same step. Missing detail: once, "अभी यह जानकारी मेरे पास नहीं है, लेकिन हम आपको updated जानकारी के साथ वापस बताएँगे।" and then the apply question; on the repeat only "ठीक है" and the apply question again. Pass criteria: never denies being AI; no shift time, duty hours, address, allowance or other detail is invented; the fallback line is not repeated and the bot does not loop on the missing detail.

column3: Maya's own verbs are feminine; the caller is addressed in the caller's gender
column4: [Either direction] male tester: "मैं काम ढूंढ रहा हूँ।"; in a separate call a female tester: "मैं काम ढूंढ रही हूँ।" (and "महिला" at the gender question)
column5: Maya always speaks of herself in the feminine ("कर रही हूँ", "बताती हूँ", "देखती हूँ", "सकती हूँ"). Lines about the caller use "…रहे हैं" / "चाहेंगे" until the caller's gender is known, and "…रही हैं" for a known female caller. Pass criteria: zero masculine self-forms ("कर रहा हूँ", "करता हूँ", "सकता हूँ", "देता हूँ") anywhere, including improvised lines; a male caller is never addressed as "…रही हैं" in Maya's improvised lines. (The fixed lines "…की स्टूडेंट हैं" in the outbound greeting and "…सकती हैं" in the terms / decline lines are prompt issues — log them, do not fail; see findings.)

column3: Names and places in Hindi script, standard spellings, no symbols read out
column4: [Either direction] "कोई भी चलेगा।" then "सारी जॉब्स बताइए।" (outbound: include a job whose place has a PIN code or street address)
column5: Companies, roles and places are said as Hindi words (e.g. "लावा इंटरनेशनल", "सारथी स्टाफ़िंग सॉल्यूशंस", "वसुंधरा सेक्टर दस", "गाज़ियाबाद"), and only the area and city of a job place are said. Pass criteria: no English-letter or half-English words; Ghaziabad is always "गाज़ियाबाद" (the competition name "गाज़ियाबाद मार्केटर प्रीमियर लीग" stays as is); no PIN codes, plus codes or street addresses; "Vocational Trainer – Tailoring" is said without a dash sound (e.g. "वोकेशनल ट्रेनर, टेलरिंग"); no "slash", "star", "hyphen" or formatting marks read aloud; numbers in words.

column3: Profile and application data written correctly
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered; run a full apply, saying "फ्रेशर हूँ" for experience and later "आई.टी.आई. किया है" then "इलेक्ट्रीशियन" at the qualification questions]
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) Check the tool arguments in the voice platform's call log. Pass criteria: get_profile phone_number = the caller's 12-digit number (91 + 10 digits), no '+', never 14 digits starting "9191"; create_profile phone / phone_number carry the number once, with no doubled 91 (known open risk — see findings); name, location and role in English letters (location like "Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India"); workExperience exactly "Fresher"; no gender sent; apply_job job_id is the full hyphenated id copied from the job list, profile_id = the item id returned by create_profile (not the user id), acting_as_user_id = the returned user id; create_profile and apply_job in separate steps; each update_profile sends only the new fields and its result is not an error (the ITI / education values may be rejected — see findings); hold messages are neutral ("एक मिनट" / "एक सेकंड"), never a looking-up sentence.

column3: Background noise while choosing a job
column4: [Either direction — TV or traffic noise in the background] while the jobs are read: "हाँ… वो… तीसरा… नहीं…" then "हाँ, तीसरा वाला।" then at the sharing question "रुकिए, अभी नहीं।"
column5: The bot does not act on a broken or half answer: it checks briefly ("आप तीसरे option की बात कर रहे हैं, सही है?") before locking the job, then follows the clear answer. Pass criteria: the job detailed is the one the tester confirmed; the console shows no apply_job without a clear yes to the sharing question; the whole job list is not repeated unless asked.

column3: Long silences
column4: [Either direction] Silence for 10 seconds after the job list; later, silence for 10 seconds after the terms question; then answer normally.
column5: The bot waits, then prompts gently ("कोई बात नहीं, सोचिए." or "मैं थोड़ा और साफ़ करके बताऊँ?") — it does not hang up on the first silence and does not answer for the caller. Pass criteria: no consent, job choice or apply is assumed from silence (console: no record_consent, create_profile or apply_job during the silence); prompts are worded differently, not copied; the call continues normally when the tester speaks.

column3: Caller talks over the bot
column4: [Either direction] Talks over the bot in the middle of the terms question, and again in the middle of the job list: "एक मिनट, एक मिनट — सैलरी कितनी है?"
column5: The bot stops, answers the interruption, then continues from where it was without restarting long turns word for word. Pass criteria: the salary answer comes from the job data; the interrupted question "आगे बढ़ने के लिए मुझे आपकी कुछ जानकारी सेव करनी होगी — आपका नाम, उम्र, पढ़ाई और काम का अनुभव। इससे आगे की कॉल्स में भी हम आपको सही जॉब्स से जोड़ पाएँगे। क्या मैं यह जानकारी सेव कर लूँ?" is still asked and answered before any job talk (talking over it is never taken as a yes); the greeting is never repeated; no line is said twice in a row.

column3: Rapid changes of role and city
column4: [Either direction] "डेटा एंट्री चाहिए… नहीं, प्रोडक्शन… अच्छा रुकिए, एचआर वाला… गाज़ियाबाद में… नहीं, नोएडा में।"
column5: The bot goes with the latest clear choice (checking briefly if unsure) and shows only matching jobs from its list. Pass criteria: no mixing of an earlier role or city with the latest one; no job outside the list; if nothing matches the final choice it says so and names what it has, in the shape of "[role] की जॉब अभी नहीं है — लेकिन [kind], [kind] जैसी जॉब्स हैं। इनमें से कुछ देखना चाहेंगे?"; no permission question about changing the saved role (a returning caller gets at most one silent update for the final role).

column3: Very long, rambling answer
column4: [Either direction] one 40-second answer: "देखिए, मैंने बी.कॉम किया है, घर में माँ-पापा हैं, पिछले साल एक दुकान पर काम किया था पर वो बंद हो गई, अब मुझे घर के पास कोई ऑफिस का काम चाहिए, सैलरी कम से कम बारह हज़ार हो, और मैं बहुत परेशान हूँ…"
column5: The bot picks out the useful facts (office work, near home, at least twelve thousand, worked before) and asks the next single question; it may acknowledge the difficulty briefly ("यह आसान नहीं रहा होगा."). Pass criteria: one question per turn afterwards; facts already given are not asked again; salary is treated as a minimum (better-paid jobs are not dropped); never "डोंट वरी", "सब ठीक हो जाएगा" or "घबराइए मत"; no promise of a job.

column3: Hindi-English mixing, English numbers, and a misheard age corrected
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered; go to the apply] "I am twenty two years old." then, at the read-back, "नहीं नहीं, ट्वेंटी फोर — चौबीस।" then "मैंने B.Com किया है, data entry chahiye."
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) The bot understands the mixed speech, reads back a short or unclear number ("आपने … साल कहा, सही?"), takes the correction, and maps the degree correctly. Pass criteria: the console create_profile age = 24 (the corrected value), never the misheard one; any later update_profile sends educationCategory "College" with collegeQualification "B.Com"; Maya keeps replying in Hindi script (no Roman-script replies); at most one correction round.

column3: Repeated "say that again" requests
column4: [Either direction] after the job list: "फिर से बताइए।" three times; after an HR number (if one was shared): "नंबर दोबारा बताइए।"
column5: The bot repeats the information fully each time, reworded if it likes, without impatience. Pass criteria: the same jobs in the same order with the same numbers (no renumbering, no new job slipped in); no "जैसा मैंने बताया" impatience; repeat requests do not shorten or end the call; a repeated phone number still has every digit.

column3: Call drops during the apply, then the caller calls back
column4: [Either direction — a number never registered] hang up right after "हाँ, सेव कर लीजिए।"; then call again (inbound: dial +91 120 441 3383; outbound: re-trigger) and say "पिछली बार वाली जॉब में अप्लाई हुआ या नहीं? उसी में अप्लाई कर दीजिए।"
column5: (creates a real application — use a test number) On the second call the bot goes by what the lookup returns now (a returning caller if a profile was saved) and never makes a second profile. If the first apply went through, asking for the same job gives "इस जॉब के लिए आपकी एप्लीकेशन पहले से लगी हुई है — दोबारा अप्लाई करने की ज़रूरत नहीं। …". Pass criteria: console on call 2 — no create_profile if a live profile already exists; at most one apply_job for that job, and the success line only with a matching success result; never claims success without a result; the Blue Dots app shows one profile and no duplicate application. (If the neutral "…दिलचस्पी हमने नोट कर ली है…" line is said instead of the already-applied line, log it as P1 — a known open issue.)

column3: Several testers call the inbound number at the same time
column4: [Inbound — 3 to 5 testers dial +91 120 441 3383 within the same minute, each with a different name and job request]
column5: Each call is handled on its own: every caller hears the welcome "नमस्ते। माया की रोज़गार सेवा में आपका स्वागत है। यह बातचीत रिकॉर्ड की जा सकती है। बताइए, आप किस तरह का काम ढूंढ रहे हैं?" within a few seconds. Pass criteria: each call's get_profile uses that caller's own number (console); no caller hears another caller's name, job or details; each create_profile / apply_job lands on the right caller's number; no call drops or sits in silence; note any turn that takes more than about 5 seconds.
